//: Configuration for markdown-link-check, used by the Documentation Check job in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
//retry: Outbound links fail transiently often enough that a single attempt is not evidence of a dead link. Retry hard, then give up quickly rather than hanging the job.
//status: Several documentation hosts answer 403 to non-browser user agents (bot protection) and 429 when the runner is rate-limited; neither means the page is gone. 200/206 are the real successes, 301/302 are redirects that markdown-link-check does not always follow.
//ignore: Two dead upstream links in vendored docs (omega-local-verifier/vendor/SafeVerify/README.md), which must not be edited: ProvablyCorrectVibeCoding.com does not resolve, and the morph-labs/lean-abc-true-almost-always repo returns 404. Neither can be machine-checked.
